summary: Iteration 28 four-feature suite (paid events / events-inbox CC / optional ticket types / bulk-import set-password emails) fully validated. Backend: 15/15 new pytest cases pass (test_iteration28_paid_events.py) and full regression suite (28 iter25 + 17 iter27 + 15 iter28 = 60 tests) passes in 30s. Coverage: paid event create persists is_paid/payment_url/payment_amount/enabled_ticket_types; event_out round-trips fields; free RSVP on paid event → 402; /payment/confirm creates pending event_ticket tx with zeffy_receipt_format='rct', NO RSVP; duplicate submit → 400 'already'; admin /approve-event-ticket creates RSVP with payment_tx_id link + increments rsvp_count + schedules email + returns {ok,rsvp_id,ticket_id}; repeat approve → {already:true}; trust_zeffy auto-approve immediately creates RSVP + returns completed status; cancelled paid event → 400; free event → 400 on payment confirm; admin PUT can toggle is_paid back to false and edit enabled_ticket_types; GET /transactions surfaces event_id+event_title via tx_out; event_ticket txs have purpose='event_ticket' so dues queue (purpose==='dues' frontend filter) is unaffected; send_rsvp_ticket_email log line confirms CC to info@alphaomegaphi.org (verified via backend log grep); bulk-import with send_set_password_emails=true generates password_set_tokens rows (7-day expiry, used=false) for every created user AND returns emails_sent_count; with send_set_password_emails=false, NO token rows are created and emails_sent_count=0. Frontend: Verified via Playwright — (a) Admin → New event dialog: event-allows-tickets-toggle present, toggling it ON reveals all 6 ticket-type checkboxes (vip/all_access/general/guest/speaker/volunteer); event-paid-toggle present, toggling ON reveals event-payment-url + event-payment-amount inputs. (b) Reports → reports-tab-event-tickets renders + event-ticket-approvals-panel renders. (c) Bulk-import dialog shows bulk-import-send-password-emails checkbox (default ON, confirmed in screenshot). (d) Events list — paid event with payment_amount=42 displays the green '💲 $42' pill with data-testid='event-card-paid-{id}' as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _create_rsvp_and_email_ticket() is a clean shared helper for both the free-RSVP and paid-after-approval paths; capacity check, ticket_id generation, counter inc, and async email task are correctly isolated.

event_payment_confirm() correctly blocks: (a) missing event 404, (b) cancelled event 400 'payments are closed', (c) free event 400 'this event is free', (d) duplicate pending/completed tx for same user+event 400 'already submitted'. The pending-OR-completed dedup query is the right move since approved RSVPs shouldn't allow a second payment either.
admin_approve_event_ticket: idempotent (status=='completed' → {already:true}), reconstructs GuestIn from tx.rsvp_guests dicts, links rsvp.payment_tx_id correctly.

send_rsvp_ticket_email CCs EVENTS_INBOX_EMAIL (default 'info@alphaomegaphi.org') only when it differs from the member's email (avoids self-CC). Log line 'RSVP ticket email sent to X (+ Y)' makes regression tests straightforward.

admin_bulk_import_members: tokens are inserted BEFORE the resend call, so a Resend 403 still leaves a usable set-password token in db.password_set_tokens — good resilience. The flag check 'send_set_password_emails AND RESEND_API_KEY' means tokens are not generated if Resend isn't configured (acceptable for prod; iteration test verified both branches).
tx_out (routes/payments.py) now correctly surfaces event_id, event_title, rsvp_id — verified end-to-end via test_transactions_surface_event_fields.

Admin.jsx EventDialog: ticket-type checkboxes only render when allows_ticket_types==true. UX nuance — when an admin opens 'New event' the toggle defaults to FALSE so no ticket-types are visible until the toggle is clicked. This matches the spec ('events can have no ticket types at all'), but worth noting for future test authors. There IS a 'Pick at least one type' amber warning when the toggle is on with an empty list.
Events.jsx event-card-paid-{id} pill renders only when is_paid==true and payment_amount > 0 — verified in DOM (green pill text '💲 $42'). Cancelled red pill still works (verified in iter27).
Reports.jsx event-ticket-approvals-panel: approve/reject buttons have data-testid={`event-ticket-approve-${tx_id}`} / `event-ticket-reject-${tx_id}` per the spec — confirmed via grep.
BulkImportMembersDialog.jsx: send-password checkbox defaults to true (matches spec). Result panel includes 'Emails sent' tile with testid bulk-import-emails-sent only after non-dry-run.

Minor (LOW): the iter27 pre-existing 'edit-event-{id}' data-testid still hasn't been added to the per-row Edit button on Admin.jsx events list — this still blocks deterministic Playwright access to the EventDialog in edit mode. Not introduced this iteration. Tracked from prior iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (event-dialog ticket-types + paid toggle, reports event-tickets tab, bulk-import checkbox, paid-pill all confirmed)

test_credentials: admin@clubhaven.app/Admin123!, member@clubhaven.app/Member123! — both work. Login UI uses two unlabelled input fields (first=email/username, second=password); selector by input order works reliably.
seed_data_creation: All test data cleaned up: test events deleted via DELETE /events/{id}, transactions+rsvps purged via mongo.delete_many, bulk-imported test users (test_iter28_a/b/c_*@example.com) deleted with their password_set_tokens. trust_zeffy flag on member@clubhaven.app is reset to false at end of trust-auto-approve test. UI-created TEST_UI_paid_pill event also deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite to inherit: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration28_paid_events.py (15 tests). Combined regression (iter25+iter27+iter28 = 60 tests, 30s wall) is green. Paid-event flow contract: member POSTs /events/{id}/payment/confirm {confirmation:'RCT-####-####', ticket_type, guests} → tx with purpose='event_ticket'. Admin PUTs /transactions/{tx_id}/approve-event-ticket (no body) → RSVP created + email scheduled. trust_zeffy=true on user doc auto-approves on valid RCT/REC/RVA receipt format. EVENTS_INBOX_EMAIL env override is honored (default info@alphaomegaphi.org). For UI tests, the allows-ticket-types toggle defaults OFF in the New-event dialog — you must click it before the 6 ticket-type checkboxes appear.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All four features (paid-events Zeffy receipt flow, events-inbox CC on ticket emails, optional/selectable ticket types, bulk-import set-password emails) implemented correctly with proper idempotency, error branches, and DB persistence. The only carryover item is the iter27-noted missing data-testid={`edit-event-${e.id}`} on the per-row Admin Events Edit button — still LOW priority and unrelated to this iteration's deliverables.
